description: Get the screenshot image data for a specific frame as base64 encoded string. If the user drew on the frame, this returns the MARKED-UP image, with each shape numbered, and returns their notes as text in `notes` ([{shape, type, note}]) keyed to those numbers - the drawing says where, the note says what. Pass original: true for the clean frame underneath.

frameIndex.description: The frame index to retrieve screenshot from (0-based)

includeMetadata.description: Include image metadata like size and format (default: false)

original.description: Return the CLEAN frame instead of the marked-up one, for looking under a drawing (default: false)

name: get_frame_screenshot
